This early mis-specification of the candidate pool propagated through availability and rating checks, leading to the wrong final answer. Although the provided rationale incorrectly claims inclusion of >120-minute films (which were actually <120), the decisive error remains the incomplete and misapplied filter at Step 1 that excluded eligible contenders.

If the filter had been correct, the correct candidate set (e.g., Nosferatu the Vampyre at 107–108 min with Adjani, or other sub-120 titles) would have been evaluated for Vudu availability and IMDB rating.
